lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's twelve? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 12? Nope!

lines.text: How many increasing geometric sequences of three whole numbers end at one hundred forty-four?
lines.caption: How many increasing geometric sequences of 3 whole numbers end at 144?

lines.text: One hundred forty-four is twelve squared, so a is b over twelve, squared.
lines.caption: 144 is 12², so a is (b/12)².

lines.text: So b is twelve k, with k a whole number.
lines.caption: So b is 12k, with k a whole number.

lines.text: k equals two gives four, twenty-four, one hundred forty-four!
lines.caption: k equals 2 gives 4, 24, 144!

lines.text: At k equals twelve, all three are one hundred forty-four. Not increasing!
lines.caption: At k equals 12, all 3 are 144. Not increasing!

lines.text: So k stops at eleven. That's eleven sequences!
lines.caption: So k stops at 11. That's 11 sequences!

lines.text: Did you get eleven? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 11? Tell me below!
